title: Beauty in DVD Menus
summary: A reflective piece exploring the artistic and creative aspects of DVD menus from the late 90s and early 2000s era, examining how these interactive interfaces represented a unique blend of design, animation, and user experience that has been largely lost with digital streaming.
problem_solved: Preserves appreciation for a forgotten era of interactive design and reminds developers how much craft went into seemingly mundane UI elements like navigation menus.
why_valuable: It offers nostalgic tech enthusiasts and designers a fresh perspective on overlooked digital artifacts, demonstrating that even functional interfaces can be expressions of creativity and artistry.
